Waymo to Launch Robotaxi Service in Singapore by 2028

Alphabet's self-driving technology company, Waymo, plans to launch its robotaxi service in Singapore by 2028. This will mark Waymo's first expansion into Southeast Asia. The service will operate as a driverless ride-hailing platform. The company has not yet released specific details about the operational areas or pricing within Singapore.
